# Phase Two — Gevurah File and System Map

## Immediate Read-Only Lanes
1. Browser/runtime: prove production-faithful `commerce-004` launcher and Radiance panel.
2. Apps crawlability: inspect app hub HTML and canonical catalog rendering/data.
3. Games crawlability: inspect game hub HTML and canonical catalog rendering/data.
4. SEO: inspect existing `PublicHtmlSeo` and metadata injection before extending it.
5. Readiness: inspect current manifest/catalog tests and CI/script discovery.
6. Telemetry: inspect existing analytics/telemetry event infrastructure and privacy boundaries.
7. Startup: trace `AwtsServer.init()` cold-start path and time major initialization stages.

## Likely Touch Surfaces After Full Reads
- `apps/index.html` and `games/index.html` only if static fallback can be safely composed without duplicating runtime UI.
- New small generator modules under a dedicated SEO/catalog generation folder.
- Existing SEO injection modules only by full-file rewrite after complete readback.
- New readiness tests and generated-manifest tests.
- New privacy-safe commerce/product event modules if no canonical telemetry layer exists.
- Startup instrumentation modules rather than invasive logging across unrelated server files.

## Hard Preservation Laws
- Never partially patch source; whole-file rewrite only.
- JS/MJS exact 3-line B"H prologue, extensive JSDoc, tabs, readable statements, strictly <120 lines.
- CSS/HTML use equivalent B"H comments where applicable.
- No minification, no compressed functions, no line shaving to satisfy limits.
- Split responsibilities before touching oversized legacy modules.
- Never overwrite prior turn planning artifacts.
